svg.title: How one lane gets StrictMath's bits
svg.desc: fdlibm's own compares on each lane's high word split the lanes of a vector in two. A common lane is computed by the vector code, fdlibm's C operation by operation. In most functions a rare lane is computed again, one at a time, by StrictMath, and that result is written over the lane. Either way the lane holds StrictMath's bits.
